slots.place: the small family nail salon with pastel walls and shelves of polish bottles
slots.counter: the manicure table by the window
slots.rival_place: glittering pink mega-spa with a giant diamond nail on the roof
slots.busy: Customers chat at the manicure tables while walls of colorful polish bottles glow.
slots.unsold: Rows of polish bottles stand untouched and every manicure chair is empty.
slots.regular_line: Best manicures in town. Don't you ever change.
slots.offer_item: One manicure chair stands empty with a fresh towel and a bottle of red polish set out, in plain view.
slots.offer_action: pats the empty manicure chair and says kindly
slots.offer_line: Chair's open. First one's on the house.
slots.taste_setup: {hero1} sits at the manicure table admiring a fresh, perfect manicure; {hero2} stands beside, curious.
slots.taste: holds the freshly painted nails up to the light: a silent stunned beat, mouth closed
slots.bad_idea_line: Okay. Ideas. A dancing polish-bottle mascot? Diamond-dust Fridays?
slots.good_idea_line: ...No. This should have a line around the block.
slots.heirloom: a framed photo of a mother at the first salon and a hand-painted sign from opening day
slots.heirloom_line: My mom's first salon. Thirty years of steady hands.
slots.craft: painting a tiny flower on a nail with a fine brush
slots.craft_line: Don't look at us. Look at the brush.
slots.payoff: a glossy pastel-pink original convertible with no badges, no emblems and no plate text
